privacy.title: Your music stays on your phone.
privacy.lead:
MusicAnalysis has no account and no upload path for audio.
Analysis runs entirely on your iPhone.
privacy.shortSummary: We do not collect personal information through the app. Analysis is on-device. There is no server upload of audio, results, or history. We do not ship analytics, ads, or tracking SDKs.
privacy.s1p1: This Privacy Policy explains how the developer (“we”) handles information when you use the iOS app MusicAnalysis (“the App”).
privacy.s1p2: The App analyses music files you choose, on the device — tempo, key, structure, instruments, loudness, and related measurements. Computation and storage of results stay on the device.
privacy.s1p3: This policy applies only to the App. It does not cover files you export elsewhere, iCloud or other backups you control, or Apple’s App Store services.
privacy.s2p1: We do not collect, transmit, or store your name, email, location, contacts, advertising identifier, usage statistics, audio files, or analysis results on servers we operate, as part of the App’s normal operation.
privacy.s2p2: The App does not implement account sign-up, login, cloud sync, or push notifications that require our servers. We do not embed third-party analytics, advertising, or behavioural tracking SDKs.
privacy.s2p3: If you voluntarily email support, the message content and header data (such as your address) may be kept temporarily in our mailbox solely to reply and handle your request. That contact is separate from the App itself.
privacy.s3p1: Audio you import is handled on-device for analysis. The App may copy parts or all of a file into its sandbox as needed for processing. This stays local.
privacy.s3p2: Analysis results (BPM, key, sections, instrument activity, loudness, etc.) are stored in a local history. You can export results as JSON yourself. Once exported, the destination (Files, AirDrop, another app) is governed by that service’s terms.
privacy.s3p3: DRM-protected content cannot be analysed. Importing audio you have no right to use, or redistributing analysis derived from it, may violate copyright or other law. You are responsible for having appropriate rights.
privacy.s3callout: We do not intend to obtain or keep the substance of your music (titles, artists, or the audio itself) via the App, and we do not build a path for us to access it.
privacy.s4p1: History and any stored audio copies generally live inside the iOS app sandbox. Depending on iOS behaviour, that data may be included in device backups such as iCloud Backup. Manage backups with normal iOS settings.
privacy.s4p2: You can delete individual tracks from the in-app library. Deleting removes that track’s results and the App’s stored audio copy from the device. This cannot be undone.
privacy.s4p3: Uninstalling the App removes much of the sandbox data. Residuals can remain depending on OS and backup behaviour. For a clean removal, delete in-app first, then uninstall, and review backups if needed.
privacy.s5p1: We do not sell, rent, or share information from the App. As stated in section 2, we do not collect it on our servers in the first place.
privacy.s5p2: Exceptions: (a) with your prior consent; (b) when required by valid legal process from competent authorities; (c) when necessary to protect life, body, or property and consent is difficult to obtain.
privacy.s5p3: Processing that Apple performs under its own policies on iOS or in the App Store is outside our control and responsibility.
privacy.s6p1: The App does not include third-party mobile analytics, ad networks, behavioural tracking, or SDK-based data export.
privacy.s6p2: We do not currently show App Tracking Transparency prompts because we do not track across apps and companies for advertising. If that changes, we will update this policy and, where practical, disclose in-app.
privacy.s6p3: Aggregate reports Apple may offer developers in App Store Connect are Apple’s statistics, not our collection of individual App usage from your device.
privacy.s7p1: The App is not directed to children under 13 (or the applicable age of digital consent). If a child used the App without required consent, contact us and we will take reasonable steps where possible.
privacy.s7p2: We do not knowingly collect personal information from children and do not implement age gates for that purpose.
privacy.s7p3: In jurisdictions with special rules such as COPPA, we do not intend to collect personal information in violation of those rules.
privacy.s8p1: Because we generally hold no personal data from the App, GDPR / CCPA / similar access, deletion, or portability rights usually have no data on our side to act on.
privacy.s8p2: If you want us to review or delete support-email records we may hold, write to us and we will respond reasonably, subject to identity verification and applicable law.
privacy.s8p3: Local history and stored audio are under your control via in-app deletion or uninstalling the App.
privacy.s9p1: We rely on iOS sandboxing and the security boundaries of Apple frameworks. We do not add a custom encryption layer over local analysis storage.
privacy.s9p2: Device loss, theft, shared screens, jailbreaks, weak passcodes, or exposed backups are under your control. Enable a strong passcode and device lock in iOS settings.
privacy.s9p3: Not sending data over the internet is not the same as perfect security. If we ever add networking for personal data, we will revise this policy first.
privacy.s10p1: We do not currently transfer audio or analysis results across borders ourselves, so GDPR-style transfer frameworks do not normally apply to the App’s core features.
privacy.s10p2: Support emails you send may be processed where our mail provider operates. Those messages are used only to respond to you.
privacy.s10p3: If we later add cloud sync or accounts, we will update this policy with transfer details and safeguards.
privacy.s11p1: The App and any analysis output are provided “as is”, without warranties of accuracy, completeness, merchantability, fitness for a particular purpose, non-infringement, or uninterrupted operation — to the maximum extent permitted by law.
privacy.s11p2: To the maximum extent permitted by law, we are not liable for indirect, incidental, special, consequential, or punitive damages, or for data loss, device issues, or rights disputes arising from your use of the App, even if advised of the possibility.
privacy.s11p3: The App is not intended as the sole basis for medical, legal, safety, or other high-stakes decisions, nor as the exclusive evidence for paid professional deliverables. You remain responsible for final judgment.
privacy.s11callout: This policy describes facts about the current implementation. It is not legal advice. If any clause is unenforceable where you live, the rest remains in effect.
privacy.s12p1: We may update this policy for legal, product, or operational reasons. Updates take effect when posted here (the “Last updated” date changes).
privacy.s12p2: For material changes — for example adding server transmission, analytics SDKs, or ads — we will try to disclose clearly on this site or in the App. We do not guarantee a particular notice channel.
privacy.s12p3: Continued use after an update may constitute acceptance. If you disagree, stop using the App and uninstall if you wish.
privacy.s13p1: This policy is governed by the laws of Japan, without regard to conflict-of-law rules, except where mandatory consumer protections in your country of residence cannot be waived.
privacy.s13p2: Disputes should first be discussed in good faith. If unresolved, courts with jurisdiction over your residence or our principal place of business shall be the forum, subject to mandatory law.
privacy.s13p3: Where translations exist, they are provided for convenience. If meanings diverge, we aim for consistency; where legal interpretation matters, the version in the language of the applicable jurisdiction should be consulted together with mandatory local law.
privacy.cBody: For privacy questions, data requests, or policy comments, email the address below. Putting “Privacy” in the subject helps.
privacy.cNote: Replies are best-effort and response times are not guaranteed. We do not currently offer a separate DPA or custom security questionnaire process.

support.title: Need a hand?
support.lead:
MusicAnalysis analyses music files right on your iPhone.
Your audio and analysis data stay on your device.
support.howIntroTitle: Pick a track. Look inside the sound.
support.howIntroBody: No account. No upload. Choose a file, wait for the analysis, open the results.
support.how1B: Select one or more audio files from the Files app.
support.how2B: Tempo, key, structure, instruments, and loudness are computed locally.
support.how3B: Results are saved in your library and can be reopened with playback anytime.
support.how4B: You can save analysis results as a JSON file when you choose to.
support.formatsBody: MP3 / AAC / WAV / AIFF / M4A / MP4 / MOV. Select files through the system file picker or the share sheet.
support.drmBody: DRM-protected tracks (for example Apple Music downloads) cannot be analysed due to iOS restrictions. Use unprotected audio files you have the right to use.
support.limitsBody: BPM, key, section, and instrument detection are machine estimates. They are not a substitute for a human transcription or calibrated studio measurement. Treat them as a reference.
support.limitsCallout: Do not rely on this app for medical, legal, or safety decisions, or as the sole basis for paid professional deliverables. The developer makes no warranty as to accuracy, completeness, or fitness for a particular purpose.
support.contactBody: For bugs, questions, or feedback, email the address below. Including the app version, iOS version, device model, and steps to reproduce helps a lot.
support.contactNote: We usually reply within a few days, but a reply is not guaranteed. Please do not attach personal data or original audio files.

faq.a: Check free storage and keep other heavy apps closed. Long tracks or large batches take more time. Restart the app and try a single track to narrow things down.

faq.q: It says the file can’t be analysed
faq.a: DRM-protected songs (such as Apple Music) are not supported. Choose an unprotected file you own or have rights to use. Some codecs may also be unsupported.

faq.q: The BPM or key looks wrong
faq.a: Estimates can appear at half/double tempo or in a nearby key. Use them as a guide, not as ground truth for professional delivery.

faq.q: How do I delete a track from my library?
faq.a: Open the row menu (…) and choose Delete. This removes the analysis result and the stored audio copy from the device. It cannot be undone.

faq.q: What happens if I delete the app?
faq.a: Library data lives on the device. Uninstalling removes analysis history and stored audio. Export JSON first if you want a copy.
